title: Personnel on the record; the 1956 Bix tribute band
summary: McPartland names the sidemen on the track and says it was his own band, recorded around 1956 as a tribute to Bix Beiderbecke.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Oh, the clarinetist was, Peanuts Hucko the clarinet player I should say is Peter (Taco?). And the trombone player is Lou McGarity. And George Wettling is on drums and on down the line, so on and so forth. Do you want to go through all that?
Now was that your own band?
My own band yes. And it was made around 1956 I think it was. It was more or less a tribute to Bix Beiderbecke. Those are numbers that he did. And that was one of them.
